paragraphs.text: Mudbutton Warren is a boggart warren on Lorwyn . Its Shadowmoor counterpart is Greasewretch Warren .

Huts built into trees rise out of the swamp, connected by twisting, raised wooden pathways. Mudbutton Warren is home to 300 residents, most of whom are boggarts, though a few daring faeries, flamekin, and changelings also make it their home. Mudbutton Warren is among the most chaotic and raucous of all the boggart warrens in Lorwyn. Travelers who stumble upon the warren's feasting time are subjected to dangerous boggart antics, though residents try to avoid harming visitors. Sometimes during feasts, visitors are asked to tell their own stories. The warren is led by Auntie Gobgot, one of its eldest residents.
